question: Can Delta accept a single grapheme whose display width is 2 as a documented width-1 wrap marker, then fail to make progress when unlimited wrapping is asked to fit text into a 2-column line?

sources.name: dandavison/delta
sources.claim: Wrap marker validation counts grapheme clusters while its error and downstream wrapping contract require display width 1; wrapping subtracts the actual marker width and unlimited mode has no line-count stop.

sources.name: unicode-rs/unicode-width
sources.claim: Delta's declared unicode-width range includes the width semantics used by the exact target lock; ordinary fullwidth CJK graphemes occupy two columns.

command: GitHub Actions: Fieldwork Delta wide wrap symbol probe

dependencies: exact dandavison/delta source fetched read-only at 95a0e224f55ccfdf3a7d1278fdea98a3edb9fbf4

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: A two-column one-grapheme marker is rejected during config creation.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: The source-level count mismatch is unreachable through normal configuration; stop the hang hypothesis.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: The marker is accepted, a one-column unlimited-wrap control terminates, and the two-column unlimited-wrap test exceeds the watchdog without completing.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Delta has a target-executed no-progress loop reachable from an accepted marker under the tested narrow line width.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Both one- and two-column unlimited-wrap cases terminate.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Another progress mechanism defeats the source-level loop hypothesis; retain a negative result.

stop_condition: Stop after target execution classifies validator reachability, the one-column negative control, and the two-column unlimited-wrap watchdog; do not propose source until an ordinary CLI path reproduces or the direct internal contract is accepted as sufficient.
network_policy: Read-only fetch of the exact public Delta revision during the owned Fieldwork CI run; no third-party repository mutation.
